# Nuvio Unmodified 0.4.16

Unmodified build of the NuvioMedia source. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NuvioMedia.

**AltStore/SideStore source:**
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/albertovinaroz/NuvioPro/pro/store-unmodified.json
```

### Changelog
- revert(mpvkit): restore published submodule revision @tapframe
- fix(home): settle hero carousel when returning @tapframe
- fix(release): target the workflow branch @tapframe
- fix(settings): require Trakt progress for continue watching window @tapframe
- perf(ui): replace compottie spinner with native drawing @tapframe
- feat(navigation): refine tablet bar and transition defaults @tapframe
- feat(navigation): add reactive bottom bar glow @tapframe
- feat(details): refine poster transition and add toggle @tapframe
- fix(navigation): refine poster transition and detail reveal @tapframe
- feat(navigation): add shared blur transition @tapframe
- feat(posters): lift original cards in zoom overlay @tapframe
- feat(navigation): update bottom tab animation @tapframe
- perf(android): add root navigation baseline profile @tapframe
- fix(settings): defer search indexing until needed @tapframe
- Merged English and Dutch strings.xml and translated all remaining English text into Dutch. (#1911) @scheperr
- i18n(el): complete and tidy up Greek translations (#1910) @nosvasedis
- i18n(vi): full Vietnamese localization refresh for Mobile (#1883) @blueocean2308
